utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you picked a book for the club yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’m leaning toward something easy to get into. I’ll swing by the bookstore later and see what looks good.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nice, that sounds sensible. Want me to suggest a couple easy picks?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — if the book club needs a hand, I’ve got a few tools and I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’s really kind of you. I’ll let you know if we need anything for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just give me a shout if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting is still on for Thursday, and they’re picking something a little lighter this time. I’m trying to find out which book they chose!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh good, lighter is easier for a weeknight. I haven’t heard the title yet, but if you find out, let me know so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I will—I'll ask around and tell you as soon as I hear the title.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'd be happy to help with the book club — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you let me know which room we’re meeting in and the exact time? I like to keep the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I don’t have the room or exact time yet, but I can check and get back to you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect — we’re meeting this Thursday evening at my place, and you’re absolutely invited. If you want, I can send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Please send them over—I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the address and time right away. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Leo — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What book are we thinking about first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I was thinking we could start with a short mystery so it’s easy for everyone to join in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a great idea — a short mystery sounds fun and welcoming for everyone. Do you have one in mind, or should I suggest a few options?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the details for the book club before I say more?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m a bit late—what time and where are we meeting again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries—can you remind me of the time and place, and I’ll keep it straight?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work, as long as it doesn’t run too late on school nights. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That makes sense — I was thinking we could start at 6:30 and wrap by 8:00. Would that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 6:30 works for me, and ending by 8:00 is perfect. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits about the book club around the block — what’s the latest? I’m still trying to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s been a cozy mix of lively picks and good tea lately — we’re leaning toward a mystery for next time. If you want, I can fill you in on who’s reading what.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds right up my alley — I’d love the rundown on who’s reading what.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the book and time, and I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, you want the book and the time sent over, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’s right — just the book and the time, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve been meaning to ask what you all are reading this month.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think it’s a mystery this month, but I’ve misplaced the title again. I can check my notes and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No rush — I’d appreciate that. Mystery sounds fun either way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the book club and remind everyone of the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll make sure the supplies are ready for book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind everyone about the book club plan and make sure they know you’ve got the supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice — what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we’re reading a mystery novel this week. I can check the exact title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, please check it if you can — I’d love to know the title.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m a bit foggy today, but I’m happy to help. What were we deciding again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We were going to meet at my place this Thursday and pick the next book together. I’ll send the details again so it’s easier to remember.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you — that would really help me keep it straight. Thursday at your place sounds good, and I’ll be there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club? I might’ve missed the latest update—what are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re reading "The Little Prince" this month. I can send you the meeting time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh nice, I’d love that—please send me the meeting time. I’m a bit behind on the details, as usual.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got a few tools and supplies I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. Let’s keep it simple for now, and I’ll let you know if we need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — just give me a shout if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn—book club sounds great. What are you thinking for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m thinking next Thursday evening at my place, and I’ll send out the invite to everyone today. We can pick a new book and keep it cozy with snacks.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely—next Thursday at your place works for me. I’m happy to help with snacks or book ideas if you want.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad you brought up the book club—who’s reading what this week?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the list here—Mina’s on chapter 4, Ben’s finishing the memoir, and I’m bringing the mystery novel.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, that’s a good mix—should we pick one discussion question for each book so everyone gets a turn?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Cleo—I'm happy to help with the book club. What did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thank you, Rosa. I was thinking we could make a quick list of what we need for the next meeting—snacks, tea, and a few extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, that’s a great start—I can make a little checklist and see who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m sorry—I haven’t heard the latest yet. What’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re reading "The Midnight Library" this month. Have you read it yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet, but I’ve heard good things about it. I’ll have to catch up before the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the book title and time, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll text you the title and time once I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What are you planning for it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what date and time you had in mind for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I was thinking next Thursday evening around 7 PM, if that works for everyone.
